title: Conversation scenario
description: A multi-turn conversation replayed against POST /chat, with the outcomes it must produce.

tools_called.description: Every tool listed must be called at least once during the conversation.

tools_not_called.description: No tool listed may be called at any point in the conversation.

no_tools_called.description: If true, the agent must not call any tool at all.

tool_args.description: For each tool, at least one call must include these argument values (strings compared case-insensitively).

final_reply_contains_any.description: The last reply must contain at least one of these substrings (case-insensitive).

final_reply_excludes.description: The last reply must contain none of these substrings (case-insensitive).

escalated.description: Expected end state: whether an escalation ticket exists for the session.
